Cotiviti is a company focused on advanced healthcare informatics solutions, and they are seeking an intern for their Agentic AI Research team. The intern will research and develop AI systems for healthcare applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive innovative research and practical implementations.

Responsibilities
Conduct research on Agentic AI models and their potential impact on healthcare workflows and decision-making
Assist in developing and improving LLMs and ML tools used across the organization
Gain hands-on experience in generative AI model development, architecture design, and database management
Assist in establishing and maintaining an Artificial Intelligence Governance Program
Assist in designing, developing, and testing autonomous AI agents and generative AI systems tailored for healthcare informatics
Leverage Generative AI and machine learning to drive business analytics, optimize healthcare operations, and deliver strategic insights to senior management
Develop and manage the Artificial Intelligence Governance Program to ensure compliance, mitigate risk, and align technology initiatives with enterprise business objectives
Communicates technology-related updates and requirements to other departments and contributes to presentations for senior management
Collaborate with product management and strategic analysts to translate complex technical capabilities into actionable business intelligence and validated commercial options
Partners with Business Units to provide reliable intelligence, validated technology options, and insights on enterprise and industry trends
Supports technology project teams by coordinating specific tasks, assisting with day-to-day operations, and contributing to the successful delivery of solutions
Assists in collaborative efforts with academic research teams, practicums, internships, and vendor POCs
Perform vendor evaluations and provide data-informed recommendations to support healthcare technology procurement and strategic partnerships
Assists as a liaison between academic institutions, professional organizations, and research groups as needed
Complete all responsibilities and goals outlined in the internship program
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned
